Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for residents, and the public opens 7 days later. Max fits the published age band. Mia is just outside it, so please check she fits before you approve. Here's the link: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026

If you approve, I'll text you a week ahead, a checklist 3 days before, a reminder the evening before, and a heads-up 15 minutes before it opens. I never register for you; I only make sure you're ready and on time. Once you pick a course, you can send me its link and the morning text will carry it too.
